items.title: Matrix Push C2 Uses Browser Notifications for Fileless, Cross-Platform Phishing Attacks
items.description: Bad actors are leveraging browser notifications as a vector for phishing attacks to distribute malicious links by means of a new command-and-control (C2) platform called Matrix Push C2. "This browser-native, fileless framework leverages push notifications, fake alerts, and link redirects to target victims across operating systems," Blackfog researcher Brenda Robb said in a Thursday report. items.title: CISA Warns of Actively Exploited Critical Oracle Identity Manager Zero-Day Vulnerability

items.title: Metasploit Adds Exploit Module for Recently Disclosed FortiWeb 0-Day Vulnerabilities
items.description: The Metasploit Framework has introduced a new exploit module targeting critical vulnerabilities in Fortinet’s FortiWeb Web Application Firewall (WAF). This module chains two recently disclosed flaws, CVE-2025-64446 and CVE-2025-58034, to achieve unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) with root privileges. items.title: Fired Techie Admits Hacking Employer’s Network in Retaliation for Termination
items.description: A former IT contractor from Ohio has admitted to launching a cyberattack against his employer’s network in retaliation for being terminated, federal prosecutors announced this week. Maxwell Schultz, 35, of Columbus, Ohio, pleaded guilty to computer fraud charges after leading a technical attack that locked thousands of employees out of their systems nationwide. items.title: CrowdStrike Fires Insider for Sharing Internal System Details with Hackers
items.description: Cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike has confirmed the termination of an insider who allegedly provided sensitive internal system details to a notorious hacking collective.
